text:
maya: Quick ping 1: Release window tonight 23:00 UTC for a small runtime change. Need someone to post internal announce + pin the RN thread.
alex: I can take the announce + pin. Will drop copy by 21:45.
sara: Draft blurb (short): "Runtime: reduced memory use and smarter batching heuristics. No API change; no migration required." Thoughts?

alex: Looks good. I'll add a fallback paragraph and rollback criteria. Proposed triggers: 5xx rate > 4% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency > 1.8x baseline for 10m. Fallback: auto-pin to model v1.3 if rollback executed.
oliver: Recommend canary longer for kv-cache warming. Suggest 10% for 25m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%. Also request deploy-bot to emit 5m heartbeat posts.
maya: agree with oliver. Update deploy cadence accordingly. @deploy-bot can you schedule?
deploy-bot: Scheduled by @alex for 2026-03-21T22:55:00Z. Canary cadence set to 10% for 25m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. Heartbeats every 5m. Canary id: 1719990000-canary.
sara: Adding runbook link to the internal blurb: https://internal.redwood/release/1719990000-runbook 
Also note: console metric rename request: update snippet to include new metric `serving.cache_warm_rate` (so teams can watch warmup behavior).
alex: Rollback command documented in case ops triggers it:
```
# rollback to last stable
deploybot rollback --release 1719990000 --to v1.3
```
maya: Who will post the internal announce at cutover? Need the pinned thread and short ops instructions.
oliver: I'll post the short announce at go-time and pin it. Will include: ops standby (me + alex), runbook link, rollback command, and key triggers.
deploy-bot: Deploy starting in ~30m. Heartbeat 1/6.
alex: Alerting thresholds configured in monitoring; PD rotations added for the window. Dashboards: https://internal.redwood/monitoring/dashboards/runtime-9555
sara: Tiny copy tweak: say "No API changes" -> "No public API changes" so docs team sees it.
maya: Good call. alex please incorporate. If rollback happens I'll lead follow-up and postmortem.
---
deploy-bot: heartbeat 3/6 10m into canary: success metrics nominal.
oliver: Observability: p99 +6% early then trending back down after cache stabilization. No error spike. Continuing ramp per cadence.
deploy-bot: heartbeat 6/6 1: Deploy to 100% complete. No alerted rollbacks.

alex: Finalized RN and posted internal announce: "Runtime memory reduction + batching improvements shipped to prod. No public API changes. Ops: @oliver @alex on standby; rollback cmd in runbook." Pinned thread.
maya: Thanks all. Leaving follow-up doc stub for post-deploy check in 24h. :raised_hands:
